{{Top|leg}}
The '''Contingency Deployment Profile''' was a set of detailed instructions distributed to all [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Stored on a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]], the profile provided information on how and where to rendezvous in the event of a breakdown in the trooper's immediate command structure.
